days.title: Ancient Monuments and Heights
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Alexanderturm
stops.detail: The highest elevation of the Bliesgau is the Großer Kahlenberg near Breitfurt at 401.1 m above sea level, on which the ruins of the Alexanderturm observation tower stand.

stops.name: Gollenstein
stops.detail: Well-known is the Gollenstein, a 4,000-year-old menhir.

stops.name: Stephanuskirche
stops.detail: The Stephanus Church in Böckweiler dates in its current form from the 11th century.

days.title: Wildlife and Bird Watching
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Naturschutzgebiet Höllengraben
stops.detail: At the Höllengraben nature reserve there is a herd of Heck cattle, water buffalo and Konik wild horses, a white stork's nest as well as populations of grey herons, wild ducks, field geese and other rare animal species.

stops.name: Fischerhütte in Beeden
stops.detail: Further white stork nests can be found at the Fischerhütte in Beeden, in Ingweiler on the Blies and in Webenheim.
